basis: ACI’s March 1 earnings release explicitly forecast consolidated Q1 2023 revenue of $280 million to $290 million. The high end was 10.24% below Q1 2022 reported revenue of $323,080,000 and $16,926,000 below the $306,926,000 threshold. The May 4 results confirmed both the decline and the prior-year comparison.

coverage.detail: September 1, 2022. ACI completed the Corporate Online Banking sale and updated Q3 and full-year 2022 guidance. The sale fell between the two March quarters. ACI’s subsequent consolidated statements retained $323,080,000 as the reported Q1 2022 comparison.

November 2, 2022. In the preceding earnings cycle, ACI guided to $1.390 billion–$1.405 billion of FY 2022 revenue. That range and the accompanying call’s outlook for the rest of 2022 supplied no Q1 2023 revenue ceiling. Subtracting nine-month actuals would imply Q4 2022 revenue.

February 15, 2023. ACI announced the March 1 reporting date and conference call. The notice gave no Q1 revenue estimate. Searches of issuer releases, filing exhibits, investor presentations and public management remarks found no earlier qualifying Q1 2023 range.

March 1, 2023. Slide 5 independently identifies $280 million–$290 million as Q1 revenue guidance. The slide applies the Corporate Online Banking and FX adjustments to the prior-year base in its separate full-year growth calculation.
April 20, 2023. ACI announced the May 4 reporting date and call without preliminary sales figures. The intervening disclosure search found no revised Q1 revenue range before results.

May 4, 2023. The condensed consolidated statements of operations report total revenue of $289,676,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2023 and $323,080,000 for the same three months of 2022. Actual revenue fell within the March 1 forecast.

publication_date_evidence: ACI’s earnings release carries a Miami dateline of March 1, 2023 and announces that day’s 8:30 a.m. ET results call.
